Return up to the first five (specNumber,crCnt) records ordered by crCnt descending, then specNumber ascending. crCnt is the distinct-CR count for that specNumber; this deterministic secondary key resolves boundary ties."}

output.query:
MATCH (cr:CR)-[:TARGET_RELEASE]->(:Release {releaseName: 'Rel-18'}), (cr)-[:MODIFIES]->(spec:Spec)
WHERE spec.specNumber IS NOT NULL
RETURN spec.specNumber AS specNumber, count(DISTINCT cr) AS crCnt
ORDER BY crCnt DESC, specNumber ASC
LIMIT 5
